cases.title: A semiconductor capital equipment company
cases.lede: Planning semiconductor equipment production when component supply is limited.
challenge: An equipment maker must decide what to build, where to build it, and which orders it can support. A shortage of one component can restrict output even when factory capacity is available.
This project connected purchasing, production, shipments, and inventory across two factories. It asked how the plan should change when suppliers cannot provide their expected capacity.
cases.approachIntro: The model linked demand to the components and factory capacity needed to serve it.

cases.title: A manufacturing company
cases.lede: Compare conflicting sales, inventory, and production records in one decision workspace.

facts.label: Supply planner, Demand planner, Manufacturing manager, Quality manager, Finance controller

challenge: Can we make and ship what was promised? The answer is hard to establish when sales requests, order schedules, material allocations, and production records disagree.
An AI answer alone is not enough. A planner needs the underlying records, the source of each claim, and a clear view of what is still unresolved.
